title: How many electrons fit in a pixel?

segments.text: How many electrons fit in a pixel?
Light hits the epitaxial silicon layer beneath the gate oxide, and the biased gate forms an n‑channel at the surface.
Each photon creates an electron‑hole pair; electrons drift to the silicon‑oxide interface and collect as a compact charge packet.
The pixel well can hold about 100000 electrons, defining its dynamic range.
When the well reaches this limit, any additional electrons would overflow.
The bucket of electrons stays ready for the next shift, all measured by how many electrons fit in a pixel.

question: Did you expect a pixel to hold that many electrons?
